fullDescription: A classic light-mode SaaS landing page on emerald-and-white with Inter type: sticky blurred nav, a centered hero with a hand-drawn underline accent and an in-app canvas mockup, logo cloud, stat strip, alternating feature rows, a bento testimonial wall, a featured 3-tier pricing table, a dark CTA banner, and a 5-column footer, fully responsive.
prompt:
## Resumo
A classic light-mode SaaS marketing landing page for 'Forma', an AI design agent: emerald-on-white palette, Inter type, a sticky blurred nav, a centered hero with a hand-drawn underline accent and an in-app product canvas mockup, a logo cloud, a 4-up stat strip, alternating feature rows plus a 3-card grid, a bento testimonial wall, a 3-tier pricing table with a featured middle plan, a dark rounded CTA banner, and a 5-column footer. Fully responsive with a mobile hamburger menu and column reflow.

## Estilo Visual
Use Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900) for everything, antialiased with optimizeLegibility; headings are font-extrabold with tight tracking (tracking-[-0.03em] on the hero h1). Brand emerald scale: brand-50 #ecfdf5, 100 #d1fae5, 200 #a7f3d0, 300 #6ee7b7, 400 #34d399, 500 #10b981, 600 #059669, 700 #047857, 800 #065f46, 900 #064e3b. Neutral 'ink' slate scale: 50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 300 #cbd5e1, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a, 950 #020617. Page bg white (#ffffff); section tint bg is ink-50 #f8fafc. Primary buttons are bg-brand-700 #047857 with white text, hover bg-brand-800 #065f46; the logo tile and accents use brand-500 #10b981; links and eyebrows use brand-600/700. Body copy is ink-500 #64748b, headings ink-900 #0f172a. Selection is brand-200 bg / brand-900 text. Define four shadow tokens: soft '0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.06)', card '0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.05), 0 12px 32px rgba(15,23,42,.08)', lift '0 24px 60px -24px rgba(15,23,42,.28)', and glow '0 18px 50px -12px rgba(16,185,129,.45)' (the emerald glow on the logo, primary CTA and featured pricing card). Background textures: a 48px slate grid (grain-grid: 1px rgba(15,23,42,.035) lines) behind the hero and testimonial sections, a 22px radial dot grid (rgba(15,23,42,.10)) inside the canvas mockup, and large blurred brand-100/brand-200 glow blobs. Corners are rounded-lg to rounded-3xl; the CTA banner is rounded-3xl. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify (ph:* and simple-icons:vercel). Strictly avoid indigo/violet AI-slop accents; the only accent family is emerald.

## Layout e Estrutura

### nav
Sticky top nav (sticky top-0 z-50), white at 85% opacity with backdrop-blur and a 1px ink-100 bottom border, h-16, max-w-6xl. Left: an 8x8 rounded-lg brand-500 logo tile with shadow-glow holding a white ph:diamonds-four-fill icon, then an extrabold 'Forma' wordmark; followed (lg and up) by text links Product (with a caret), Showcase, Pricing, Resources in ink-600. Right: a 'Log in' text link (sm+), a solid brand-700 'Start free' button with a right-arrow icon, and a hamburger (ph:list-bold) shown only below lg that toggles a bordered mobile menu panel of stacked links.

### hero
Centered hero on ink-50 with the 48px grid texture and two blurred emerald glow blobs. A pill badge (white, brand-200 border) with a brand-700 'New' chip reading 'Forma 2.0 — multi-frame canvas is live'. Extrabold headline up to ~58px, leading-[1.05], tracking-[-0.03em]: 'Ship the interface, not just the prototype', where 'prototype' is brand-600 and underlined by an inline hand-drawn SVG squiggle stroked #10b981. Subcopy in ink-500 ~17px, max-w-xl. Dual CTAs: a brand-700 'Start designing free' button with shadow-glow, plus a white outlined 'Watch the demo' button with a brand-700 ph:play-circle-fill icon. Below, a small trust line with a brand-700 check: 'No credit card · Free forever plan · 2-minute setup'.

### hero-product-mockup
Below the hero copy, a max-w-5xl in-app canvas mockup (NOT a browser bar): rounded-t-2xl white card with shadow-lift, an app chrome bar ('Untitled canvas · Pricing flow' on the left, Frame/Components pills and a brand-700 'Generate' pill on the right). A 12-column body: a left rail (lg only, col-span-3) with a 'Prompt' card ('A 3-tier SaaS pricing section, emerald accent, monthly/annual toggle.') and a brand-50 'Generating…' chip, plus a layers tree; and a dotted-grid canvas (col-span-9) holding a miniature 3-card pricing block where the middle 'Pro $29' card has a brand-500 2px border, shadow-glow and a 'Popular' tab. A floating ink-900 'Forma AI' cursor pill sits top-right.

### logo-cloud
A logo cloud band on a white-to-ink-50 gradient with a top hairline: a centered uppercase tracked eyebrow 'Trusted by product teams shipping fast', then a flex-wrap row of 6 muted ink-500 brand lockups (icon + bold wordmark): Vercel, Northwind, Loopframe, Orbital, Voltage, Nucleus, at ~80% opacity.

### stat-strip
A bordered stat strip on white: max-w-6xl grid, 4 columns on lg (2 on mobile), each cell centered with a ~34px extrabold number and an ink-500 label; columns 2-4 carry a left ink-100 divider on lg. Stats: 4.2M+ screens generated, 12× faster to first draft, 57k builders on the canvas, and a brand-600 4.9/5 average maker rating.

### features
A 'Why Forma' section on white. Centered header: a brand-50 uppercase pill eyebrow, an extrabold h2 up to ~42px 'Design software your whole team will love', and ink-500 subcopy. Then two alternating two-column rows (lg:grid-cols-2): row 1 text-left/visual-right ('Prompt to UI in one breath', a rounded-xl chat-to-screen mockup with a brand-700 Send chip and toggle rows); row 2 visual-left/text-right ('Real components, kept in sync', a component-library card showing Button/Badge/Input/Avatar tiles and a '128 in sync' chip) using order utilities to swap sides on desktop. Each text block has an 11x11 brand-50 rounded-xl icon tile, an extrabold h3, body, a 3-item check list (ph:check-circle-fill in brand-500), and a brand-700 text link with arrow. Below, a 3-card grid (md:grid-cols-3) of feature cards (Infinite canvas, Live collaboration, Drives your coding agent) each with a brand-50 icon tile and hover lift (-translate-y-0.5 to shadow-card).

### testimonials
A 'Loved by makers' bento testimonial wall on ink-50 with the grid texture. Centered header (white pill eyebrow + extrabold h2 'See how teams ship faster with Forma'). A responsive grid (md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) where the first card is a large brand-600 solid-emerald card spanning 2 rows on lg, white text, a ph:quotes-fill mark, a bold blockquote, and an avatar-initials + name/role footer. The remaining 5 cards are white bordered cards each with a 5-star brand-500 rating, an ink-700 quote, and a brand-100 avatar-initials with name/role.

### pricing
A pricing section on white. Centered header with a brand-50 'Pricing' eyebrow, extrabold h2 'Plans that scale with your team', subcopy, and a Monthly/Annual segmented toggle (rounded-full ink-50 track, white active pill with shadow, 'Annual -20%' with brand-700 discount). Then a 3-column plan grid (lg:grid-cols-3): Starter $0 and Scale $99 are white bordered cards with outlined secondary buttons; the middle Pro $29 card is featured with a brand-500 2px border, shadow-glow, a centered 'Most popular' brand-700 ribbon overlapping the top edge, a brand-700 title, and a solid brand-700 'Start Pro trial' button. Each card has a price row ($N + /mo), a CTA, and a check-list of features (ph:check-bold in brand-500).

### cta-banner
A full-width dark CTA banner: a rounded-3xl ink-900 panel with shadow-lift, two blurred emerald glow blobs bleeding off the corners, centered white extrabold h2 'Your next screen is a sentence away', ink-300 subcopy ('Join 57,000 builders…'), and dual CTAs: a brand-700 'Start designing free' with shadow-glow and a translucent white-outline 'Talk to sales'.

### footer
A footer on ink-50 with a top hairline: a 5-column grid (lg:grid-cols-5) where the brand block spans 2 columns (logo tile + wordmark, a one-line description, and a row of 4 white ring-1 social icon chips that recolor to brand-600 on hover) and three link columns (Product, Company, Resources) with uppercase ink-900 headings and ink-500 links. Below, a top-bordered legal bar: copyright on the left, Privacy/Terms/Security links on the right, stacked on mobile and row-spaced on desktop.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Sticky blurred nav (white/85 + backdrop-blur) with an emerald glowing logo tile and a mobile hamburger that toggles a stacked menu panel.

### Componente
Hand-drawn SVG underline squiggle (#10b981) anchored under the emerald hero keyword 'prototype'.

### Componente
In-app product canvas mockup: app chrome bar (not a browser bar), a left prompt/layers rail, and a dotted-grid canvas containing a mini 3-tier pricing block with a glowing featured 'Pro' card and a floating 'Forma AI' cursor pill.

### Componente
Pill badge with an inline solid 'New' chip announcing a release.

### Componente
4-up stat strip with vertical hairline dividers and one emerald-colored hero stat.

### Componente
Alternating feature rows that swap visual/text sides via order utilities, each with a brand-50 rounded-xl icon tile and a check-list, plus a 3-up hover-lift feature-card grid.

### Componente
Bento testimonial wall with one large solid-emerald spanning card plus white star-rated quote cards using avatar-initials.

### Componente
3-tier pricing with a featured middle card (2px emerald border, shadow-glow, 'Most popular' overlapping ribbon) and a Monthly/Annual segmented toggle.

### Componente
Dark rounded-3xl CTA banner with emerald glow blobs as the page's single dark moment.

### Componente
5-column footer with a 2-col brand block, social icon chips, and a top-bordered legal bar.

## Notas Especiais
Light mode only, emerald-on-white; the dark CTA banner is the sole dark surface. Keep all copy WCAG-legible: body in ink-500 #64748b on white, never lighter for paragraph text, and white text only on brand-600/700/ink-900 fills. Maintain the four shadow tokens (soft/card/lift/glow) for depth; the emerald 'glow' shadow is reserved for the logo, primary CTAs and the featured pricing card. Preserve the sticky blurred nav, the hero underline squiggle, the dotted-grid product mockup, and full responsive reflow (hamburger menu, 4-up→2-up stats, multi-column→stacked grids). Use Phosphor (ph:*) icons and Inter only. Strictly avoid generic indigo/violet SaaS slop accents. No em-dashes in any copy.

Responsive: desktop multi-column grids collapse to stacked single columns on mobile; the nav switches to a hamburger that toggles a panel; the pricing/feature/footer grids reflow; the stat strip goes 4-up to 2-up.
